title: Follow-up assistant
intro: Approval tasks of the documents you asked for, follow or made the purchase order of that are past their due time or due within a day, with why each still waits
source: From the system's rules and data, not from AI
rule: A follow-up goes only when you press send, and only to the task's holder in the DOA's own order · one follow-up per task a day, and none within 2 hours after the system told the holder of the task
list: Tasks past or near their due time
forbidden: You may not open this page

empty.title: No task is past or near its due time
empty.hint: The approval tasks of the documents you follow have more than a day left. The assistant lists them here when they come near their due time

reason.acting: Waiting for {name} to decide on behalf of {principal}, who set an acting delegate
reason.actingUntil: Waiting for {name} to decide on behalf of {principal}, who set an acting delegate until {until}
reason.away: {name} set an acting delegate until {until}, but this task did not move to the delegate, so it still waits for {name}
reason.slaReminded: The system reminded {name} on time at {when}
reason.overdueTold: The system told {name} it was overdue at {when}
reason.escalates: If still undecided, the system escalates it under the SLA at {when}
reason.escalatedWith: The system escalated it at {when}: {names} now decides it too
reason.sentToday: {name} sent a follow-up on this task today at {when}
reason.sentTodayMe: You sent a follow-up on this task today at {when}

hold.SENT_TODAY: This task may be followed up again {when}
hold.TOLD_RECENTLY: {name} was just told of this task by the system; a follow-up may go {when}

draft.viaLINE: LINE (e-mail if LINE is not linked)
draft.hint: {name} reads this message in BCS · LINE and e-mail carry only the document's number and a link, not your words
draft.confirmLINE: The system tells them by LINE (or e-mail if LINE is not linked) that there is a follow-up on {document} {number}. The message below shows in the BCS of {name}, and you are recorded as the sender
draft.confirmEMAIL: The system tells them by e-mail that there is a follow-up on {document} {number}. The message below shows in the BCS of {name}, and you are recorded as the sender
draft.tooLong: A message may have at most {max} characters
draft.OVERDUE: Dear {name}, may I follow up on {document} {number}, which waits for your review and was due {due}, thank you.
draft.DUE_SOON: Dear {name}, may I follow up on {document} {number}, which waits for your review and is due {due}, thank you.

errors.SENT_TODAY: Someone already followed up on this task today; it may go again {when}
errors.TOLD_RECENTLY: The holder was just told of this task by the system; it may go {when}
errors.NOT_FOLLOWER: You no longer follow this document, so you may not follow up on it
errors.READ_ONLY: You follow this document as an auditor, who reads only, so you may not follow up on it
errors.OWN_TASK: This task waits for your own decision
errors.NOT_DUE_SOON: This task is not near its due time yet
errors.HOLDER_INACTIVE: The holder of this task is no longer active; please tell your organization's administrator
errors.STATE: This task no longer waits for a decision. Reload the page to see where it stands
errors.BUSY: The system is busy. Please try again in a moment
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back, so it is not certain the follow-up went. You may press send again; it will not go twice
errors.FAILED: It could not be sent. Please try again
